observations: Photo 0 shows a large boxed copier/printer-like machine on a table, wrapped in plastic.
Brand text on the box reads 'FRANCOSDETOIA' (appears like a label/mark on the packaging, not clearly a copier brand).
No visible model number, no control panel, no ports, no toner/drum close-ups, and no powered-on/print sample.

claims.evidence: Only a wrapped boxed unit is shown; no model/specs to confirm it is multifunctional or to price it.
The unit is wrapped in plastic; cleanliness of internal parts and surfaces cannot be verified.
No powered-on test print/copy sample is shown.

risks.risk: Whether it actually works (power-on, scanning, copying) and whether there are faults (fuser/laser/rollers). Photos cannot confirm functionality.
risks.proof: A short video of the machine powering on and producing a test copy (showing the output page) plus a scan-to-email/USB demonstration.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not proven/possibly non-working until tested.

risks.risk: Exact brand/model is unclear; without it, compatibility and parts availability/pricing in Lagos is uncertain.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the model/serial label on the machine body (not the box), and a photo of the control panel/menus.
risks.if_unproven: Priced at the worst case for unknown copier (generic used unit value, not model-specific).

risks.risk: Consumables status (toner level, drum condition, waste toner, fuser life) affects real usability and cost.
risks.proof: Photos of toner/drum indicators (or inside panels if accessible) and a print counter/maintenance page.
risks.if_unproven: Priced assuming consumables may be low/near end-of-life.

risks.risk: Packaging/handling damage risk (even if boxed, shipping damage can cause paper path or imaging issues).
risks.proof: Photos of the machine after unboxing from multiple angles, focusing on paper tray rails, hinges, and any visible dents/cracks.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as potentially damaged until inspected after unboxing.

proof_requests: Clear photo of the machine’s model/serial label on the device (and control panel).
Video of power-on and a test copy showing sharp text/graphics.
Video or photo proof of scanning (e.g., scan to USB or email) if it is truly multifunctional.
Maintenance/print counter page and toner/drum status indicators.
response.reason: The photos only show a wrapped boxed unit with no readable model and no powered-on test. Without proof of functionality and identity, a worst-case price cannot be set confidently.
